## Description

Measure momentum in returns unexplained by broad market/factor exposures, then rank securities by residual trend.

## Where it may fit

Markets where idiosyncratic information diffusion matters beyond market beta.

## Vehicles

Quant equity long-short funds and factor portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time security returns, factor returns, rolling regression residuals and universe/borrow data.

## Caveats

Depends on factor model and estimation window; turnover and factor drift matter.
